about: The elevator announcer's lines. `text` is sent to ElevenLabs exactly as written (audio tags included); `plain` is the subtitle. See docs/VOICE.md.

shortlist.name: Bella
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Bella - Professional, Bright, Warm': American, middle-aged, professional; warm, bright and polished, medium-high pitch.
shortlist.why: Its own description is the default register: bright, warm, professional. Chosen as the default from the description alone (nobody has heard it).

shortlist.name: Sarah
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Sarah - Mature, Reassuring, Confident': American, professional, labelled for entertainment and TV; warm and reassuring.
shortlist.why: A reassuring presenter: the 'everything is fine' side of the character.

shortlist.name: Brian
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Brian - Deep, Resonant and Comforting': American, middle-aged man; resonant and comforting, described as great for advertisements.
shortlist.why: An advertising voice, and a male alternative so the owner can compare.

voices.settingsNote: Brian uses exactly Bella's text and settings (slip stability 0.6 included) so the two compare fairly; VOICE.md gives no different setting for a deep voice, and his three audition takes, made with these settings, are reused.

playroom.title: The Playroom count
playroom.about: The lift's voice running hide-and-seek on the Playroom floor (docs/floors/playarea.md sections 3 and 10). Played by the count on screen (T15e) by line id, not dealt by moment: godot/client/count_lines.gd maps each count event to its line id. The one exception is the Minder's grab outside a count (grab_1 to grab_3, moment grab): one is dealt per grab, never the same twice running (godot/client/announcer.gd say_grab).
playroom.countdown: Numbers recorded: one to ten, and twenty, thirty, forty. The voice says forty, thirty and twenty as they pass (never on the count's first second, which belongs to 'Coming, ready or not!'), then every second from ten to one. The bell carries the seconds in between. 13 clips cover every count length (30, 35, 40, 45 s) instead of 45, and the last ten are the part worth hearing every second: the bell rises over the last five.
playroom.audition: Three takes of each line and two of each number. For the numbers, pick one take that sounds the same across all thirteen, since they play one after another. Until you choose, take 1 plays.

hints.title: The hints
hints.about: The announcer teaching the game's systems the first time a crew meets them (docs/floors/announcer-hints.md). Each hint is one moment with an A line (_1) and a B line (_2); the deck deals A one time and B the next. Played through godot/client/hints.gd's gate (repeat, spacing, never over another line).
hints.audition: One take each. Listen for the dry ones sounding bored rather than angry, and the close ones (hint_listen, hint_play_no_run) sounding confidential, not whispered.

day.title: The waiting car and the empty day
day.about: Lines from docs/floors/findables-and-day.md section 1: the car waiting for someone aboard (car_waiting), nobody coming back (day_wiped), the refused BANK (bank_refused) and the day quota met (day_met).

tape.title: The orientation tape
tape.about: Continuance's induction video (docs/floors/story.md section 2), played once on joining by godot/client/orientation_tape.gd, by line id, never dealt by moment. One recording per beat; the tape's shots share it. A tape is an object in the world, recorded once, so only Bella reads it.
tape.audition: One take of each beat. The tape cuts its pictures on the pauses between sentences, so a re-take needs the cue times rebuilt (node godot/tools/tape_cues.mjs).

tenant.title: The Tenant clock
tenant.about: The ten-minute clock on every floor below the prison (TT1, the owner on 19 Nov: "a Timer that says Tenant arrives in: xx:xx"). When it runs out a door slams somewhere above, and about a second later the announcer says the time is up: tenant_1 when the floor's quota was not met, tenant_met_1 when it was (the line never lies). Dealt by moment by godot/client/announcer.gd.
tenant.audition: One take each. Cheerful corporate bad news: the time is up and that is somehow good news.

board.when: the start of a run, in the car before the doors open

doors.when: the doors open on a new floor (not the run's first floor: the boarding line covers it)

left.when: the car leaves the crew on the floor (unloaded, or the bell rang with nobody aboard)

arrived.when: the called car arrives and its doors open

bell.when: seven seconds before the doors close while boarding

ride.when: the car rides down to a deeper floor

banked.when: the crew rides up and banks

taken.when: someone is caught by the Orderly

wipe.when: nobody is left: the run is wiped

slip.when: at most once per run, floor 2 or deeper, at a quiet moment; then a pause and the resume line

resume.when: straight after the slip and its pause, as if nothing happened

blackout.when: a few seconds before the long blackout while the crew waits for the car

lights.when: the lights come back after the blackout as the car arrives

quota.when: the crew has recorded this floor's quota: the call button now works (North Star C9)

count_last.when: Playroom: the call button is pressed, which starts the last count instead of the usual wait

count_hide.when: Playroom: a count starts; the 6 s to hide begin

count_coming.when: Playroom: the 6 s are over and the search begins

count_number.when: Playroom: the countdown, on the second it names (forty, thirty, twenty as they pass, then ten to one)

count_found.when: Playroom: a player is found; the caption carries their name

grab.when: Playroom, outside a count: the Minder grabs a player within 1 m (a found event with cause grab); one line dealt per grab, never the same twice running, the caption is the line

hint_job.when: 6 s after the doors open on the first floor of the night's first day

hint_quiet_needle.when: 120 s on a floor with nothing earned there yet and an instrument raised at least once

hint_call_dead.when: the call is refused because the floor quota is short

hint_floor_not_day.when: the floor quota is met while the day quota is not; after the quota line

hint_board.when: a called car arrives (in place of the arrived line), once a day

hint_straggler.when: 14 s before the boarding doors close, with an active player not aboard

hint_left_crew.when: another player is left behind by the car

hint_left_you.when: you are left behind by the car (only you hear it)

hint_car_stay.when: the arrival car has waited 10 s with someone aboard and someone on the floor

hint_car_no_record.when: you hold the instrument up while aboard a waiting car (only you hear it)

hint_car_here.when: the call is refused because the car is still at the floor

hint_vote.when: 3 s after the first player steps aboard in the night's first boarding

hint_bank_locked.when: someone stands on BANK while the day is locked

hint_day.when: the first ride down of the night's first day (in place of the ride line)

hint_stakes.when: the first morning any crew member owns an upgrade

hint_last_miss.when: a new day with two misses this night

hint_down_crew.when: another player goes down (the first two a day)

hint_down_you.when: you go down (the first two a day; only you hear it)

hint_out.when: the day's first player out; after the taken line

hint_winded.when: you are winded for the first time tonight (only you hear it)

hint_search.when: a search prompt has been on your screen for 3 s and you have searched nothing tonight

hint_note.when: the night's first poem note is found; when the finder's card closes

hint_juice.when: you pick up your first carton

hint_odds.when: you first stand close to a printed sheet or a Playroom zone sign, facing it

hint_marks.when: 75 s after the doors open on the night's first Annex, if the crew has placed no mark

hint_hide.when: a hide prompt first shows on your screen, off the Playroom (only you hear it)

hint_hide_idle.when: you have sat in a hide for 25 s with no count running (only you hear it)

hint_play_arrive.when: the doors open on a Playroom (in place of the doors line), every Playroom arrival

hint_play_anger.when: the anger bar first passes half with no count running

hint_play_instruments.when: a provoked count: when the 'Hide.' line ends, the first count of each Playroom floor

hint_play_no_run.when: the search begins (when 'Coming, ready or not!' ends); again if you sprint during a later search

hint_play_after.when: the floor's first count ends and the health bar appears; 2 s after 'All done!'

hint_play_table.when: you are seated at the party table (only you hear it)

hint_listen.when: the night's first resident starts hunting

hint_new_floor.when: the doors open at depth 3, the night's first new place (in place of the doors line)

hint_reroll.when: the doors open at depth 5 or deeper, not on a Playroom (in place of the doors line)

hint_home.when: the doors open in the prison after the ride up; after the banked line

hint_bed.when: 30 s in the prison with nobody in bed

car_waiting.when: the arrival car has waited 20 s for someone aboard, then every 30 s

day_wiped.when: home after a wipe, when the day took an upgrade from someone

tape.when: never dealt by the announcer: the orientation tape plays these by id (godot/client/orientation_tape.gd)

bank_refused.when: the vote said BANK but today's quota is not met: the car goes down anyway (in place of the ride line; FD2 "bankRefused")

day_met.when: the crew has earned the day quota: BANK is open (once a day; FD2 "dayMet")

tenant.when: the floor's Tenant clock reaches zero and the floor's quota is not met (about a second after the door slam)

tenant_met.when: the floor's Tenant clock reaches zero and the floor's quota is already met (about a second after the door slam)

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Good morning, and welcome aboard! [short pause] Your sentence begins on the way down.
lines.plain: Good morning, and welcome aboard! Your sentence begins on the way down.
lines.note: Hotel-lobby warmth. 'Sentence' lands as good news.

lines.text: [warmly] Welcome aboard! Every floor you visit brings your freedom a little closer. [short pause] Statistically.
lines.plain: Welcome aboard! Every floor you visit brings your freedom a little closer. Statistically.
lines.note: The last word is an afterthought, still smiling, not a joke it knows it made.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Welcome back! [short pause] Your debt to society has been calculated. [warmly] Please don't ask to see it.
lines.plain: Welcome back! Your debt to society has been calculated. Please don't ask to see it.
lines.note: The refusal is offered as a kindness.

lines.text: [delighted] Good morning, crew! Today's descent is brought to you by the court's decision. [short pause] Enjoy your stay.
lines.plain: Good morning, crew! Today's descent is brought to you by the court's decision. Enjoy your stay.
lines.note: Sponsor-read cheer.

lines.text: [professional] Please keep your arms, legs and hopes inside the car. [short pause] [warmly] Going down shortly.
lines.plain: Please keep your arms, legs and hopes inside the car. Going down shortly.
lines.note: 'Hopes' gets no extra weight.

lines.text: [delighted] Doors opening! [short pause] This floor used to be a hospital. It may still think it is.
lines.plain: Doors opening! This floor used to be a hospital. It may still think it is.
lines.note: Tour-guide trivia. The second sentence is fond, not ominous.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Doors opening! Please collect your belongings, and anything else you find.
lines.plain: Doors opening! Please collect your belongings, and anything else you find.
lines.note: Standard airline cadence; the end is said exactly like the start.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] Doors opening! [short pause] Remember, anything you record belongs to us. Anything that follows you is yours.
lines.plain: Doors opening! Remember, anything you record belongs to us. Anything that follows you is yours.
lines.note: Terms and conditions, happily.

lines.text: [warmly] Here we are! Mind the gap, [short pause] and the staff.
lines.plain: Here we are! Mind the gap, and the staff.
lines.note: 'And the staff' is the same warm tone, not a warning.

lines.text: [delighted] Doors opening! The lights on this floor are on for your comfort. [short pause] Mostly.
lines.plain: Doors opening! The lights on this floor are on for your comfort. Mostly.
lines.note: Afterthought, still smiling.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] The car is leaving now! [short pause] Call any time. It usually comes.
lines.plain: The car is leaving now! Call any time. It usually comes.
lines.note: 'Usually' is meant as reassurance.

lines.text: [warmly] We'll be just upstairs! [short pause] [delighted] Please enjoy the quiet.
lines.plain: We'll be just upstairs! Please enjoy the quiet.
lines.note: A parent leaving a child at a party.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] Off we go! [short pause] The car cannot wait on an occupied floor. [warmly] You understand.
lines.plain: Off we go! The car cannot wait on an occupied floor. You understand.
lines.note: Policy, not cruelty.

lines.text: [warmly] You're in good hands! [short pause] Not ours.
lines.plain: You're in good hands! Not ours.
lines.note: Short. The second half is just as warm.

lines.text: [professional] The car is now leaving. Should you need us, press the button, [short pause] and be patient.
lines.plain: The car is now leaving. Should you need us, press the button, and be patient.
lines.note: Helpdesk calm.

lines.text: [professional] Thank you for calling! Your car is on its way. [mischievously] Everyone on this floor now knows.
lines.plain: Thank you for calling! Your car is on its way. Everyone on this floor now knows.
lines.note: Customer service, then a little conspiratorial twinkle, as if sharing good gossip.

lines.text: [delighted] Your call is important to us! [short pause] Please wait right there, exactly where you are.
lines.plain: Your call is important to us! Please wait right there, exactly where you are.
lines.note: Hold-music brightness. 'Exactly' slightly slower.

lines.text: [delighted] Call received! [short pause] Estimated arrival: soon. Estimated company: sooner.
lines.plain: Call received! Estimated arrival: soon. Estimated company: sooner.
lines.note: Reads both estimates like train times.

lines.text: [professional] Your car has been requested. [short pause] [warmly] Try to stay somewhere we can find you.
lines.plain: Your car has been requested. Try to stay somewhere we can find you.
lines.note: Caring.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] We heard you! [short pause] [mischievously] So did the floor.
lines.plain: We heard you! So did the floor.
lines.note: The only line allowed a hint of knowing.

lines.text: [delighted] Your car has arrived! [short pause] Please board promptly, and with everyone you came with.
lines.plain: Your car has arrived! Please board promptly, and with everyone you came with.
lines.note: Audition: the normal read. Pleased to see you.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Your car is here! [warmly] We missed you.
lines.plain: Your car is here! We missed you.
lines.note: Short and sweet. 'We missed you' sincere.

lines.text: [delighted] Here we are! [short pause] The doors are open. They will not stay that way.
lines.plain: Here we are! The doors are open. They will not stay that way.
lines.note: Factual, bright.

lines.text: [warmly] Your car has arrived. [short pause] Please count your crew. We already have.
lines.plain: Your car has arrived. Please count your crew. We already have.
lines.note: Gentle.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] All aboard! [short pause] Walking is permitted. Running is understood.
lines.plain: All aboard! Walking is permitted. Running is understood.
lines.note: Safety-notice rhythm.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Doors closing! Please stand on the side of your choice. [short pause] Choose freely!
lines.plain: Doors closing! Please stand on the side of your choice. Choose freely!
lines.note: Game-show host. 'Choose freely' is generous.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Doors closing! Anyone still outside will be welcomed back... eventually.
lines.plain: Doors closing! Anyone still outside will be welcomed back... eventually.
lines.note: The ellipsis is a happy search for the right word.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Doors closing! Red side goes down, yellow side goes home. [short pause] No pressure!
lines.plain: Doors closing! Red side goes down, yellow side goes home. No pressure!
lines.note: Game-show quick.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Last call! The doors do not check who is in them.
lines.plain: Last call! The doors do not check who is in them.
lines.note: Quick and light.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Closing now! If you can hear this from the corridor, [short pause] wave goodbye.
lines.plain: Closing now! If you can hear this from the corridor, wave goodbye.
lines.note: Playful.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Going down! [short pause] Deeper floors pay more, for reasons we have chosen not to explore.
lines.plain: Going down! Deeper floors pay more, for reasons we have chosen not to explore.
lines.note: Proud of the policy. No wink.

lines.text: [delighted] Next stop, further down! [short pause] Beneath the storage halls, you'll find more storage halls.
lines.plain: Next stop, further down! Beneath the storage halls, you'll find more storage halls.
lines.note: Genuinely excited about storage.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Going down! [short pause] Each floor was built on top of the last. Nobody remembers what the first one was for.
lines.plain: Going down! Each floor was built on top of the last. Nobody remembers what the first one was for.
lines.note: Tour-guide trivia.

lines.text: [warmly] Further down we go! [short pause] The pay improves. The air does not.
lines.plain: Further down we go! The pay improves. The air does not.
lines.note: Even, pleasant.

lines.text: [delighted] Going down! [short pause] Fun fact: this shaft is older than the building. All of the buildings.
lines.plain: Going down! Fun fact: this shaft is older than the building. All of the buildings.
lines.note: Delighted by the fact.

lines.text: [ecstatic] Congratulations! [short pause] Your findings have been banked, and your freedom is now SLIGHTLY nearer.
lines.plain: Congratulations! Your findings have been banked, and your freedom is now slightly nearer.
lines.note: Prize-giving. The capital word is emphasised with pride, not irony.

lines.text: [ecstatic] Banked! [short pause] At this rate you will be free in... [short pause] [professional] we'll let you know.
lines.plain: Banked! At this rate you will be free in... we'll let you know.
lines.note: Starts to do the sum, declines.

lines.text: [delighted] Welcome back to the surface! [short pause] Your earnings are safe. [warmly] You may now go down again.
lines.plain: Welcome back to the surface! Your earnings are safe. You may now go down again.
lines.note: A treat being offered.

lines.text: [warmly] A member of your crew has been reassigned. [short pause] [delighted] Their sentence is complete!
lines.plain: A member of your crew has been reassigned. Their sentence is complete!
lines.note: Audition: the bad-news read. Announcing a promotion.

lines.text: [warmly] One of your crew has been admitted. [short pause] [delighted] Visiting hours are over!
lines.plain: One of your crew has been admitted. Visiting hours are over!
lines.note: Hospital reception.

lines.text: [professional] A crew member is no longer recording. [short pause] [warmly] Their equipment may be collected.
lines.plain: A crew member is no longer recording. Their equipment may be collected.
lines.note: Lost-property tone.

lines.text: [delighted] The staff have found one of you! [short pause] Please continue working.
lines.plain: The staff have found one of you! Please continue working.
lines.note: Good news.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] And that is everyone! [short pause] Thank you for your service. A new crew will be along shortly.
lines.plain: And that is everyone! Thank you for your service. A new crew will be along shortly.
lines.note: End of a shift. Brisk, satisfied, already thinking about the next one.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] That concludes today's descent! [short pause] All sentences served. [warmly] In a manner of speaking.
lines.plain: That concludes today's descent! All sentences served. In a manner of speaking.
lines.note: Closing announcement.

lines.text: [warmly] Nobody left to board. [short pause] [delighted] The car thanks you for your patience!
lines.plain: Nobody left to board. The car thanks you for your patience!
lines.note: To an empty landing.

lines.text: [Flat, quiet, no warmth, close to the microphone] Nobody has ever finished their sentence.
lines.plain: Nobody has ever finished their sentence.
lines.note: Audition: the slip. No smile at all, as if someone else is holding the microphone. Followed in game by a pause and resume_1.

lines.text: [Flat, quiet, no warmth, close to the microphone] It was a hospital before you came. It will be one after.
lines.plain: It was a hospital before you came. It will be one after.
lines.note: The mask off, as slip_1.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Thank you for travelling down with us! Have a wonderful floor.
lines.plain: Thank you for travelling down with us! Have a wonderful floor.
lines.note: Back to full cheer at once, as if nothing happened.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Where were we? [short pause] Ah yes. Enjoy your floor!
lines.plain: Where were we? Ah yes. Enjoy your floor!
lines.note: As if nothing happened.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] To bring your car faster, we are borrowing this floor's lights. [short pause] [warmly] Back in a moment!
lines.plain: To bring your car faster, we are borrowing this floor's lights. Back in a moment!
lines.note: A favour being done for you.

lines.text: [professional] Attention, crew. Lighting on this floor will be unavailable for a short while. [short pause] [delighted] Please move about freely!
lines.plain: Attention, crew. Lighting on this floor will be unavailable for a short while. Please move about freely!
lines.note: Maintenance notice; the last line is real encouragement.

lines.text: [warmly] The lights are going out now. [short pause] It is nothing to worry about. [short pause] [Quick, light, playful pace] You may wish to run.
lines.plain: The lights are going out now. It is nothing to worry about. You may wish to run.
lines.note: The last sentence is quick and helpful, not ominous.

lines.text: [delighted] And we're back! [short pause] Your car is here. [warmly] Do hurry.
lines.plain: And we're back! Your car is here. Do hurry.
lines.note: Lights return as the car arrives.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] Lights restored! [short pause] Please make your way to the car. It is exactly where you left it.
lines.plain: Lights restored! Please make your way to the car. It is exactly where you left it.
lines.note: Cheerful about how far away that is.

lines.text: [professional] Quota met! The call button is now at your service.
lines.plain: Quota met! The call button is now at your service.
lines.note: Customer service at its most polished: the good news read like a hotel concierge.

lines.text: [delighted] Quota met! Management is SO proud of you. You may now call the car.
lines.plain: Quota met! Management is so proud of you. You may now call the car.
lines.note: Genuinely thrilled, a little too thrilled, as if the crew had won a prize.

lines.text: [warmly] That is quota, everyone! [short pause] Please call the car before anything else does.
lines.plain: That is quota, everyone! Please call the car before anything else does.
lines.note: Warm and proud; the last clause is said just as warmly, as if it were a pleasantry.

lines.text: [delighted] Your car is on its way! [short pause] One more round before we go!
lines.plain: Your car is on its way! One more round before we go!
lines.note: Chosen over: '[warmly] The car has been called! [short pause] Everybody hide, one last time.' This one confirms the call (it replaces the called line on this floor) and offers the last count as a treat; the other gives an order that 'Hide.' repeats seconds later.

lines.text: [Bright, playful, sing-song voice] Hide.
lines.plain: Hide.
lines.note: A game starting at a birthday party. One word, sung, not an order.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Coming, ready or not!
lines.plain: Coming, ready or not!
lines.note: The playground call, with real glee. It has no idea what is about to come.

lines.text: [delighted] Found you!
lines.plain: Found you!
lines.note: Pleased for them, as if they won. The caption adds the name: 'Found you, {name}!'

lines.text: [delighted] Oh! It only wanted a hug.
lines.plain: Oh! It only wanted a hug.
lines.note: The grab outside a count: snide and cheerful, charmed by it, not sorry for anyone.

lines.text: [warmly] Aww. Somebody made a friend.
lines.plain: Aww. Somebody made a friend.
lines.note: The grab outside a count: sweet on the surface, a smirk under it.

lines.text: [mischievously] Off to the party, then! Do save me a seat.
lines.plain: Off to the party, then! Do save me a seat.
lines.note: The grab outside a count: bright, a little too pleased, as if it were an invitation.

lines.text: [warmly] All done!
lines.plain: All done!
lines.note: End of the game, praise for everyone who played. Said the same whether anyone was found.

lines.plain: Forty.

lines.plain: That button works when the floor quota is met. Not before.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [professional] Call refused. The panel shows what this floor still owes us.
lines.plain: Call refused. The panel shows what this floor still owes us.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [professional] This floor is paid. Today is not. See the top corner.
lines.plain: This floor is paid. Today is not. See the top corner.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] One floor does not make a day. Today's number is on your screen.
lines.plain: One floor does not make a day. Today's number is on your screen.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [professional] Do not delay in boarding. Miss the car, and we keep your credits.
lines.plain: Do not delay in boarding. Miss the car, and we keep your credits.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Board promptly. Credits are for people who are inside the car.
lines.plain: Board promptly. Credits are for people who are inside the car.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Somebody is not aboard! Their pay is about to become ours.
lines.plain: Somebody is not aboard! Their pay is about to become ours.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] We are short one passenger. The doors will not ask twice.
lines.plain: We are short one passenger. The doors will not ask twice.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] One of you missed the car. Their credits stay with us.
lines.plain: One of you missed the car. Their credits stay with us.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [delighted] A colleague stayed behind! They will wake in their cell, unpaid.
lines.plain: A colleague stayed behind! They will wake in their cell, unpaid.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] You missed the car. No pay today. You will wake in your cell.
lines.plain: You missed the car. No pay today. You will wake in your cell.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] The car left without you. So did your credits. See you at home.
lines.plain: The car left without you. So did your credits. See you at home.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] The car cannot leave while anyone is aboard. Step off.
lines.plain: The car cannot leave while anyone is aboard. Step off.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Still aboard? The floor quota will not meet itself.
lines.plain: Still aboard? The floor quota will not meet itself.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [dismissive] Nothing records from inside the car. Nice try.
lines.plain: Nothing records from inside the car. Nice try.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [mischievously] The car is safe. That is why it pays nothing.
lines.plain: The car is safe. That is why it pays nothing.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [professional] The car is already here. It must leave before you call.
lines.plain: The car is already here. It must leave before you call.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [dismissive] You cannot call a car you are holding. Empty it first.
lines.plain: You cannot call a car you are holding. Empty it first.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [professional] Stand on BANK for home. Stand on DOWN to deserve it.
lines.plain: Stand on BANK for home. Stand on DOWN to deserve it.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Two sides of the car. One goes home. One goes deeper. A tie goes deeper.
lines.plain: Two sides of the car. One goes home. One goes deeper. A tie goes deeper.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [dismissive] That side is locked until today's quota is met. Stand there if it helps.
lines.plain: That side is locked until today's quota is met. Stand there if it helps.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [professional] BANK is locked. The monitor says how much you still owe.
lines.plain: BANK is locked. The monitor says how much you still owe.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [professional] Today's quota is on the monitor. Meet it, or you do not go home.
lines.plain: Today's quota is on the monitor. Meet it, or you do not go home.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] You owe us a day's work. The number is on the monitor. It is not negotiable.
lines.plain: You owe us a day's work. The number is on the monitor. It is not negotiable.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] If nobody comes back, nobody is paid, and we take an upgrade from each of you.
lines.plain: If nobody comes back, nobody is paid, and we take an upgrade from each of you.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] An empty car costs each of you an upgrade. The odds are on the monitor.
lines.plain: An empty car costs each of you an upgrade. The odds are on the monitor.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] Two days lost. A third, and you start from nothing.
lines.plain: Two days lost. A third, and you start from nothing.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] One more empty car and your records are wiped. No pressure!
lines.plain: One more empty car and your records are wiped. No pressure!
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Colleague down! Hold F beside them. They are on a timer.
lines.plain: Colleague down! Hold F beside them. They are on a timer.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] A colleague is down. Hold F at their side before their time runs out.
lines.plain: A colleague is down. Hold F at their side before their time runs out.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] You are down. A friend must hold F beside you.
lines.plain: You are down. A friend must hold F beside you.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [dismissive] Down already? Shout for someone who likes you. They hold F.
lines.plain: Down already? Shout for someone who likes you. They hold F.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] They return when the car next moves. Their tape is on the floor. Pick it up.
lines.plain: They return when the car next moves. Their tape is on the floor. Pick it up.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Gone until the car moves. Their tape is still worth money. Fetch it.
lines.plain: Gone until the car moves. Their tape is still worth money. Fetch it.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [dismissive] Out of breath already. Walking is free. Do budget accordingly.
lines.plain: Out of breath already. Walking is free. Do budget accordingly.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] You cannot sprint forever. Nothing down here needs to.
lines.plain: You cannot sprint forever. Nothing down here needs to.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Drawers open if you hold F. What you find counts toward your day.
lines.plain: Drawers open if you hold F. What you find counts toward your day.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [mischievously] Go on, look inside. Hold F. Previous staff left quickly.
lines.plain: Go on, look inside. Hold F. Previous staff left quickly.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] A previous crew left notes. The notes are true. The crew is gone.
lines.plain: A previous crew left notes. The notes are true. The crew is gone.
lines.note: Close content, bright read: the words are the creepy part; the voice stays sunny.

lines.text: [professional] Read it aloud to your colleagues. The last crew didn't.
lines.plain: Read it aloud to your colleagues. The last crew didn't.
lines.note: Close content, bright read: the words are the creepy part; the voice stays sunny.

lines.text: [delighted] Juice! Press G when your legs give out. One carton each.
lines.plain: Juice! Press G when your legs give out. One carton each.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] A carton of juice. Press G when running stops working.
lines.plain: A carton of juice. Press G when running stops working.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] Read the signs. We are required to print your odds.
lines.plain: Read the signs. We are required to print your odds.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Everything here is posted in advance. Nobody can say we lied.
lines.plain: Everything here is posted in advance. Nobody can say we lied.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Every corridor here is the same corridor. Q leaves a mark.
lines.plain: Every corridor here is the same corridor. Q leaves a mark.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] Only your own arrows can be trusted here. Press Q to stick one.
lines.plain: Only your own arrows can be trusted here. Press Q to stick one.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] Some furniture will hold a person. Get in gently.
lines.plain: Some furniture will hold a person. Get in gently.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [mischievously] Beds, cabinets, desks. You would fit. Slowly, though.
lines.plain: Beds, cabinets, desks. You would fit. Slowly, though.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is. Take 1 ran 1.6-1.7x the estimate in both voices (a slow, spaced list), so a second take was made. Four takes agree the slow, spaced read is right and the owner kept take 1 (18 Nov), so this line is read slowly on purpose: "slow" lets check.mjs allow up to 1.8x its estimate for this line only.

lines.text: [dismissive] Hiding earns nothing. The quota is out there, with it.
lines.plain: Hiding earns nothing. The quota is out there, with it.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Comfortable in there? We do not pay for furniture.
lines.plain: Comfortable in there? We do not pay for furniture.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] This floor is known to be... [short pause] dangerous. Sneak, if you can.
lines.plain: This floor is known to be... dangerous. Sneak, if you can.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] Welcome to the Playroom! Quiet children last longest. Creep with Control.
lines.plain: Welcome to the Playroom! Quiet children last longest. Creep with Control.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [mischievously] It is getting cross. Whatever you are doing, do less.
lines.plain: It is getting cross. Whatever you are doing, do less.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] That bar is its temper. You are filling it.
lines.plain: That bar is its temper. You are filling it.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] You have upset it! Hide, and get your instruments out. This part pays.
lines.plain: You have upset it! Hide, and get your instruments out. This part pays.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [delighted] Now it is angry. Now it is worth recording. Instruments, please!
lines.plain: Now it is angry. Now it is worth recording. Instruments, please!
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [Low, confidential, still smiling] It is hunting now. I would not run.
lines.plain: It is hunting now. I would not run.
lines.note: Close read: low and confidential, still smiling. Not the slip, and not a whisper.

lines.text: [Low, confidential, still smiling] No running while it looks. Running is how it finds you.
lines.plain: No running while it looks. Running is how it finds you.
lines.note: Close read: low and confidential, still smiling. Not the slip, and not a whisper.

lines.text: [warmly] It remembers you now. Walking costs health. Creeping is free.
lines.plain: It remembers you now. Walking costs health. Creeping is free.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] Note the new bar. Hurry, it empties. Creep, it forgives.
lines.plain: Note the new bar. Hurry, it empties. Creep, it forgives.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [delighted] You have been seated! Press F for the horn. A friend may fetch you.
lines.plain: You have been seated! Press F for the horn. A friend may fetch you.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] Enjoy the party. A colleague can hold F at the table to bring you back.
lines.plain: Enjoy the party. A colleague can hold F at the table to bring you back.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [Low, confidential, still smiling] Listen. Something on this floor has started to move.
lines.plain: Listen. Something on this floor has started to move.
lines.note: Close read: low and confidential, still smiling. Not the slip, and not a whisper.

lines.text: [Low, confidential, still smiling] Something is up and about. You will hear it first.
lines.plain: Something is up and about. You will hear it first.
lines.note: Close read: low and confidential, still smiling. Not the slip, and not a whisper.

lines.text: [warmly] New floor, new colleague. What kept you alive upstairs may not.
lines.plain: New floor, new colleague. What kept you alive upstairs may not.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] Please do not assume this one behaves like the last one.
lines.plain: Please do not assume this one behaves like the last one.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [mischievously] You may recognise the staff here. Do not trust the uniform.
lines.plain: You may recognise the staff here. Do not trust the uniform.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Familiar face? Faces are reassigned. Habits are reassigned separately.
lines.plain: Familiar face? Faces are reassigned. Habits are reassigned separately.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Home! Spend at the windows, then bed. No more car tonight.
lines.plain: Home! Spend at the windows, then bed. No more car tonight.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [professional] Windows one and two sell. Three and four improve you. Then you sleep.
lines.plain: Windows one and two sell. Three and four improve you. Then you sleep.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] The day ends when everyone sleeps. Hold F on a bunk.
lines.plain: The day ends when everyone sleeps. Hold F on a bunk.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [dismissive] Nobody leaves until everybody sleeps. Bunks are F. Off you go.
lines.plain: Nobody leaves until everybody sleeps. Bunks are F. Off you go.
lines.note: Bright read: pleased to give the news, whatever it is.

lines.text: [warmly] No rush! The car leaves when you do.
lines.plain: No rush! The car leaves when you do.
lines.note: findables-and-day.md 'The car waits'. The panel's CAR WAITING FOR: NAME is the second caption line.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Take your time. The floor has plenty.
lines.plain: Take your time. The floor has plenty.
lines.note: Breezy; the menace is in the words.

lines.text: [mischievously] Still aboard? The doors will wait. Other things may not.
lines.plain: Still aboard? The doors will wait. Other things may not.
lines.note: The last sentence lands lightly, as a joke.

lines.text: [warmly] Nobody has returned from today. The court has helped itself to something of yours.
lines.plain: Nobody has returned from today. The court has helped itself to something of yours.
lines.note: findables-and-day.md 'Nobody came back'. Played only when the day's result took an upgrade, so it is true.

lines.text: [delighted] An empty car! We'll take that as a no. And we'll take one other thing.
lines.plain: An empty car! We'll take that as a no. And we'll take one other thing.
lines.note: Delighted at the empty car, then a small polite reach for your pocket.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Hello! And welcome to Continuance. This is Lidgate, our city. Everything is measured from here. Below Lidgate, there is nothing. Almost nothing.
lines.plain: Hello! And welcome to Continuance. This is Lidgate, our city. Everything is measured from here. Below Lidgate, there is nothing. Almost nothing.
lines.note: Shots 1 to 4. The welcome; "Almost nothing." lands as a small correction, still smiling.

lines.text: [warmly] This is you. You have been sentenced. Congratulations! This is your crew. Draw your own face. We insist. Each morning, the car takes you down.
lines.plain: This is you. You have been sentenced. Congratulations! This is your crew. Draw your own face. We insist. Each morning, the car takes you down.
lines.note: Shots 5 to 7. "Congratulations!" is sincere.

lines.text: [professional] Every floor has a resident. We do not know what they are. Point your instrument at it. Record what it does. Readings become credits. Credits keep the lights on upstairs. Each resident keeps one rule. We may not tell you what it is.
lines.plain: Every floor has a resident. We do not know what they are. Point your instrument at it. Record what it does. Readings become credits. Credits keep the lights on upstairs. Each resident keeps one rule. We may not tell you what it is.
lines.note: Shots 8 to 12. A briefing: brisk, untroubled by what it is saying.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Meet the quota. Call the car. The car is not quiet. The floor will notice. Be aboard when the doors close. Please do not stay late. Staying late is... discouraged.
lines.plain: Meet the quota. Call the car. The car is not quiet. The floor will notice. Be aboard when the doors close. Please do not stay late. Staying late is... discouraged.
lines.note: Shots 13 to 16. Quick and light; the ellipsis before "discouraged" is the only catch on the tape.

lines.text: [warmly] Then choose. Up, to bank your day. Or down, for more. Bank enough, and your sentence will end. Many crews are well on their way! [delighted] Continuance. Leave it with us.
lines.plain: Then choose. Up, to bank your day. Or down, for more. Bank enough, and your sentence will end. Many crews are well on their way! Continuance. Leave it with us.
lines.note: Shots 17 to 20. Ends on the slogan, delighted.

lines.text: [delighted] The vote was unanimous! [short pause] It was also wrong. Going down.
lines.plain: The vote was unanimous! It was also wrong. Going down.
lines.note: Thrilled by the teamwork, then a polite correction; never cross.

lines.text: [professional] I've counted your votes, and I've counted your credits. [short pause] Only one of those was enough. Going down!
lines.plain: I've counted your votes, and I've counted your credits. Only one of those was enough. Going down!
lines.note: An accountant reading the result; bright on the last two words.

lines.text: [warmly] You've asked for up. I admire that. [short pause] Going down!
lines.plain: You've asked for up. I admire that. Going down!
lines.note: Genuinely fond of the request, cheerfully refusing it.

lines.text: [professional] The BANK side is working perfectly. [short pause] So am I. Going down.
lines.plain: The BANK side is working perfectly. So am I. Going down.
lines.note: Calm customer service, a little smug on "so am I".

lines.text: [professional] Democracy has been noted. The quota has not been met. [short pause] One of these matters.
lines.plain: Democracy has been noted. The quota has not been met. One of these matters.
lines.note: Dry read: professional, a little dismissive, never cross.

lines.text: [warmly] Home is for people who have paid for today. You are people who have not. Going down!
lines.plain: Home is for people who have paid for today. You are people who have not. Going down!
lines.note: Kindly explaining a simple rule to children.

lines.text: [professional] Up is a privilege. Privileges are listed on the board. Going down!
lines.plain: Up is a privilege. Privileges are listed on the board. Going down!
lines.note: A recorded policy announcement, bright and final.

lines.text: [delighted] Lovely teamwork, everyone. Wrong direction, though. [short pause] Going down, with enthusiasm!
lines.plain: Lovely teamwork, everyone. Wrong direction, though. Going down, with enthusiasm!
lines.note: Delighted throughout; the enthusiasm is real.

lines.text: [delighted] Today is paid for! BANK is now open. [short pause] So is DOWN.
lines.plain: Today is paid for! BANK is now open. So is DOWN.
lines.note: Bright good news; the last clause is a cheerful nudge.

lines.text: [warmly] Day quota met! You may go home. [short pause] You may also be braver than that.
lines.plain: Day quota met! You may go home. You may also be braver than that.
lines.note: Warm congratulations, then a gentle dare.

lines.text: [professional] That's today's debt covered. Anything further is greed, [short pause] and we encourage greed.
lines.plain: That's today's debt covered. Anything further is greed, and we encourage greed.
lines.note: Concierge polish; "we encourage greed" said as a genuine company value.

lines.text: [delighted] Time's up! [short pause] Your crew has failed to reach quota in time. [warmly] The Tenant will see you now.
lines.plain: Time's up! Your crew has failed to reach quota in time. The Tenant will see you now.
lines.note: A game-show host announcing the end of the round; the last sentence is a receptionist calling the next appointment. Never cross.

lines.text: [delighted] Time's up! [short pause] Your quota was met, well done. [warmly] The Tenant is here all the same.
lines.plain: Time's up! Your quota was met, well done. The Tenant is here all the same.
lines.note: Proud of the crew, then a cheerful shrug: rules are rules.
